text: Salesforce is a US enterprise software company with its head office in San Francisco, California.
quote: Salesforce, Inc. is an American enterprise software company headquartered in San Francisco, California.

text: Salesforce was started in March 1999 as a SaaS company by ex-Oracle executive Marc Benioff along with Parker Harris, Dave Moellenhoff and Frank Dominguez.
quote: Salesforce was founded on March 8, 1999, by former Oracle executive Marc Benioff, together with Parker Harris, Dave Moellenhoff, and Frank Dominguez as a software-as-a-service (SaaS) company.

text: Salesforce listed on the New York Stock Exchange in June 2004 under the ticker CRM, raising $110 million.
quote: In June 2004, the company had its initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange (under the stock symbol CRM) and raised US$110 million.

text: Salesforce posted record annual revenue of $41.5 billion for fiscal year 2026.
quote: For fiscal year 2026 (ending January 31, 2026), the company reported record annual revenue of $41.5 billion.

text: Salesforce bought Tableau, a visual analytics and business intelligence platform, for $15.7 billion in August 2019.
quote: Salesforce acquired the visual analytics and business intelligence software platform Tableau in August 2019 for $15.7 billion.

text: Salesforce's biggest deal to date is Slack, announced in December 2020 at $27.7 billion and closed in July 2021.
quote: In December 2020, Salesforce announced its acquisition of Slack for $27.7 billion, the largest in company history; the deal closed in July 2021.

text: In January 2023 Salesforce announced it would cut about 10% of its staff, roughly 8,000 positions.
quote: In January 2023, the company announced a layoff of about 10%, or approximately 8,000 positions.

text: Salesforce has a free CRM offering aimed at small teams of no more than two people.
quote: Salesforce also offers a free CRM for small teams of up to two people.

text: Salesforce rolled out Agentforce, an agentic AI that succeeded Salesforce Einstein, in September and October 2024.
quote: In September and October 2024, the company deployed Agentforce (succeeding Salesforce Einstein), an agentic AI.

text: Salesforce's AppExchange, launched in 2005, is an online app store where users can sell third-party applications and consulting services.
quote: Launched in 2005, the Salesforce AppExchange is an online app store that allows users to sell third-party applications and consulting services.

text: Salesforce said in November 2025 that it had completed its purchase of Informatica, a deal worth about $8 billion in equity value.
quote: In November 2025, Salesforce announced the successful completion of its acquisition of Informatica for approximately $8 billion in equity value.

text: Salesforce operates 110 offices, with locations including Hong Kong, Tel Aviv, London, Paris, Sydney and Tokyo.
quote: Salesforce has 110 offices, including offices in Hong Kong, Tel Aviv, London, Paris, Sydney and Tokyo.

text: In September 2025 Benioff was criticized after announcing that Salesforce had cut about 4,000 customer service roles following its rollout of AI-powered support agents.
quote: In September 2025, Benioff drew criticism after announcing that Salesforce had eliminated approximately 4,000 customer service roles following the deployment of AI-powered support agents.

text: A former Salesforce senior director, Dina Zelikson, sued the company in San Francisco Superior Court in September 2024, alleging wrongful termination, discrimination and retaliation during a medical leave.
quote: In September 2024, former Salesforce Senior Director Dina Zelikson filed a lawsuit against the company in San Francisco Superior Court, alleging wrongful termination, discrimination, and retaliation during a medical leave.

text: As of September 2024, Salesforce Ventures had put $5 billion into companies across 27 countries.
quote: As of September 2024, Salesforce Ventures has invested $5 billion in companies based in 27 different countries.

text: In June 2026 Salesforce announced an agreement to buy Fin, an AI customer-service platform, for about $3.6 billion.
quote: Also in June 2026, Salesforce announced an agreement to acquire Fin, an artificial intelligence customer-service platform, for approximately $3.6 billion.

text: Zendesk was founded in Copenhagen in 2007 and now has its headquarters in San Francisco, California.
quote: The company was founded in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

text: Zendesk's founders are Morten Primdahl, Alexander Aghassipour and Mikkel Svane.
quote: Zendesk was founded in Copenhagen, Denmark in 2007 by three friends: Morten Primdahl, Alexander Aghassipour, and Mikkel Svane.

text: Zendesk closed a $19 million series C in December 2010 and a $60 million series D in 2012.
quote: Zendesk raised $19 million in a series C funding round in December 2010, followed by $60 million in a series D funding round in 2012.

text: Zendesk bought the Australian company Local Measure for $100 million in February 2025.
quote: In February 2025,  Zendesk acquired Australian company Local Measure for $100 million.

text: Zendesk filed for an IPO in 2014 at a valuation of $1.7 billion, and the offering raised $100 million.
quote: In 2014, Zendesk filed an initial public offering and was valued at $1.7 billion. The IPO raised $100 million.

text: Zendesk's first acquisition was Zopim, a live-chat company it bought for $29.8 million.
quote: That same year, Zendesk announced its first acquisition. It bought a live-chat company called Zopim for $29.8 million.

text: In 2015 Zendesk opposed 49 trademarks containing the word "zen" at the United States Patent and Trademark Office.
quote: In 2015, Zendesk filed oppositions at the United States Patent and Trademark Office to 49 trademarks including the word "zen".

text: Zendesk launched Zendesk Suite in 2018, bringing social media, live chat, email and other channels together in one ticket system.
quote: In 2018, the company introduced Zendesk Suite, which combines social media, live-chat, email, and other communications into a single ticket system.

text: Zendesk's annual revenue had reached $500 million by 2018.
quote: By 2018, Zendesk had annual revenues of $500 million.

text: Zendesk revealed in October 2019 that it had been hacked in 2016, potentially leaking information about customer service agents who use Zendesk.
quote: In October 2019, Zendesk disclosed that it was hacked in 2016, resulting in a potential leak of information about customer service agents using Zendesk.

text: Zendesk announced a $4.13 billion deal for Momentive Global, formerly SurveyMonkey, in October 2021, but its investors rejected the deal on February 25, 2022 and the agreement was terminated.
quote: In October 2021, Zendesk announced that it was acquiring Momentive Global Inc., formerly SurveyMonkey, for $4.13 billion. Zendesk's investors rejected the deal on February 25, 2022, and terminated the agreement due to risk.

text: Zendesk announced on November 22, 2022 that an investor group led by Hellman & Friedman and Permira had acquired it for about $10.2 billion.
quote: On November 22, 2022, Zendesk announced that it had been acquired by a group of investors led by Hellman & Friedman and Permira for approximately $10.2 billion.

text: HubSpot is a US customer relationship management firm with headquarters in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
quote: HubSpot, Inc. is a US customer relationship management firm and data broker. It is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

text: HubSpot bought Oneforty, a Twitter app store founded by Laura Fitton, in 2010.
quote: In 2010, HubSpot acquired Oneforty, the Twitter app store founded by Laura Fitton.

text: HubSpot filed with the SEC for an IPO on August 25, 2014, seeking a New York Stock Exchange listing under the ticker HUBS.
quote: HubSpot filed for an IPO with the Securities and Exchange Commission on August 25, 2014, requesting to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol HUBS.

text: In July 2017 HubSpot acquired Kemvi, a company that uses artificial intelligence and machine learning to help sales teams.
quote: In July 2017, HubSpot acquired Kemvi, which applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to help sales teams.

text: HubSpot announced its first-ever layoffs on January 31, 2023, cutting about 500 employees, or 7% of its workforce.
quote: On January 31, 2023, HubSpot announced the first layoffs in the company's history. Affecting approximately 500 employees, this layoff eliminated 7% of its total workforce.

text: HubSpot announced in November 2023 that it was acquiring Clearbit, a B2B intelligence firm.
quote: Hubspot announced its acquisition of B2B intelligence firm Clearbit in November 2023.

text: HubSpot shares jumped 5% after Reuters reported in April 2024 that Google was weighing a bid for the company.
quote: In April 2024, Reuters reported that Google was considering a bid to acquire HubSpot. The report led to shares of the company spiking by 5%.

text: HubSpot dismissed its CMO, Mike Volpe, in July 2015 for breaching the company's code of business conduct.
quote: In July 2015, HubSpot's CMO, Mike Volpe, was dismissed for violating HubSpot's code of business conduct.

text: HubSpot changed its bylaws in March 2026 so that U.S. federal courts are the exclusive forum for securities law claims.
quote: In March 2026, HubSpot amended its bylaws to designate U.S. federal courts as the exclusive forum for securities law claims.

text: PCMag picked HubSpot Marketing Hub as its Best Overall email marketing software in January 2026.
quote: In January 2026, PCMag named HubSpot Marketing Hub its Best Overall email marketing software

text: Asana was founded in 2008 by Dustin Moskovitz and Justin Rosenstein.
quote: Asana, Inc. was founded in 2008 by Dustin Moskovitz and Justin Rosenstein.

text: Asana was valued at $5.5 billion after its direct listing in September 2020.
quote: In September 2020, the company was valued at $5.5 billion following its direct listing.

text: Asana's Series C in 2016 brought in $50 million and was led by Sam Altman, President of Y Combinator.
quote: In 2016, Asana raised $50 million in Series C financing led by Sam Altman, President of Y Combinator.

text: By January 2018 Asana had over 35,000 paying customers, among them eBay, Uber and IBM.
quote: By January 2018, more than 35,000 paying customers were using Asana, including CityFibre, AB-InBev, Viessmann, eBay, Uber, Overstock.com, Navy Federal Credit Union, Icelandair, and IBM.

text: Asana raised a $75 million Series D led by Generation Investment Management, a firm backed by Al Gore.
quote: That same year, the company raised $75 million in Series D funding led by Generation Investment Management, a firm backed by Al Gore.

text: Asana added a second listing on the Long-Term Stock Exchange in August 2021.
quote: In August 2021, Asana dual listed on the Long-Term Stock Exchange.

text: Asana had 131,000 customers as of September 2022.
quote: As of September 2022, Asana had 131,000 customers.

text: Asana named Dan Rogers, previously at LaunchDarkly, ServiceNow and Rubrik, as CEO in June 2025, while Moskovitz stayed on as chairman.
quote: In June 2025, Asana appointed Dan Rogers, formerly of LaunchDarkly, ServiceNow, and Rubrik, as CEO, with Moskovitz remaining as chairman.

text: Asana paid $75 million in May 2026 for StackAI, a no-code AI workflow-automation platform.
quote: In May 2026, Asana acquired StackAI, a no-code artificial intelligence workflow-automation platform, for $75 million.

text: Asana introduced AI Studio in October 2024 so that companies can customize AI agents to carry out jobs and actions across product development stages and workflows.
quote: In October 2024, Asana launched AI Studio to help companies customize their AI agents to perform jobs and actions across product development stages and workflows.

text: Monday.com is an Israeli software company headquartered in Tel Aviv.
quote: Monday.com Ltd. (styled in lowercase as monday.com) is an Israeli software company based in Tel Aviv.

text: Monday.com started out in 2012 under the name DaPulse and took its current name in 2017.
quote: The company began in 2012 as DaPulse, before renaming itself  Monday.com in 2017.

text: Monday.com opened its API to third-party developers in June 2020.
quote: In June 2020, monday.com released its API to third-party developers.

text: Monday.com reported 2,508 employees and more than 245,000 customers as of 2025.
quote: As of 2025, the company reported it had 2,508 employees, and was serving over 245,000 customers.

text: Monday.com is run by its co-founders, Eran Zinman and Roy Mann, as co-CEOs.
quote: Co-founders Eran Zinman and Roy Mann serve as co-CEOs.

text: Monday.com let go 20 percent of its workforce in July 2026 following an AI restructuring.
quote: In July 2026,  monday.com fired 20 percent of its work force in the wake of AI restructuring.

text: Freshworks was founded as Freshdesk in Chennai, India, in 2010 by Girish Mathrubootham and Shan Krishnasamy, both former Zoho employees.
quote: Freshworks was founded in 2010 by former Zoho employees Girish Mathrubootham and Shan Krishnasamy in Chennai, India, as Freshdesk.

text: Freshworks relocated its headquarters to San Mateo, California, in 2018.
quote: The company moved their headquarters to San Mateo, California, in 2018.

text: Freshworks raised $1.03 billion in its IPO.
quote: In its initial public offering, Freshworks raised $1.03 billion

text: Zoho accused Freshworks in 2020 of stealing its intellectual property, and the resulting lawsuit was settled in 2021.
quote: In 2020 Zoho accused Freshworks of stealing Zoho's intellectual property, and the lawsuit was settled in 2021.

text: Freshworks bought Device42, a US IT-management firm, for $230 million in May 2024.
quote: Freshworks acquired Device42, an American IT-management firm, for $230 million in May 2024.

text: Freshworks said 2025 was its first GAAP-profitable year, with net income of $183.7 million on $838.8 million in revenue.
quote: Freshworks reported 2025 as its first GAAP-profitable year, with net income of $183.7 million on revenue of $838.8 million.
